edges.reason: Constructor trusts the untrusted msg.sender and grants it signer privileges, making the deployer the initial authority.
Constructor writes isSigner[msg.sender] = true, seeding the authorization state used by sign and execute.
Constructor pushes the deployer address into the allSigners array.
Constructor initializes activeSignersCount to one, fixing the initial quorum denominator.
sign reads the untrusted caller address to enforce the isSigner authorization requirement.
sign gates execution on isSigner[msg.sender] and later authorizes scripts that depend on this mapping.
sign loads and mutates the Script struct held in the scripts mapping.
The scripts mapping supplies the storage pointer used by sign for state and signCount updates.
The scriptAddress parameter indexes the scripts mapping inside sign.
sign appends the script address to scriptAddresses on the first signature.
sign calls the abstract checkQuorum hook with the accumulated signature count.
checkQuorum consumes activeSignersCount as the quorum denominator.
StabilityBoardProxy overrides the abstract checkQuorum declaration.
The concrete quorum implementation reads activeSignersCount to compute a strict majority.
execute reads the untrusted caller address to enforce the isSigner requirement before running a script.
execute relies on the isSigner mapping as its only access control gate.
execute reads and overwrites the Script state in the scripts mapping (Failed then Done).
The scriptAddress parameter selects the script entry processed by execute.
The scriptAddress argument is used directly as the delegatecall target, letting a malicious script run arbitrary code in the MultiSig context.
execute performs the low-level delegatecall to the approved script address.
The delegatecall re-enters the target contract code, which can call back into MultiSig functions before the state is finalized.
cancelScript compares the untrusted caller with address(this), restricting the function to self-calls.
cancelScript writes the Cancelled state into the scripts mapping.
The scriptAddress parameter indexes the scripts mapping inside cancelScript.
addSigners validates the untrusted caller via msg.sender == address(this), i.e. only reachable through an executed script.
addSigners grants new privileges by setting isSigner[signers[i]] = true, modifying the authorization state.
addSigners appends every newly activated signer to the allSigners array.
The signers array parameter supplies the addresses processed by addSigners.
addSigners performs the unchecked activeSignersCount++ counter update.
The unchecked increment writes to activeSignersCount, which defines quorum and therefore signature authority.
removeSigners validates the untrusted caller via msg.sender == address(this), i.e. only reachable through an executed script.
removeSigners revokes privileges by setting isSigner[signers[i]] = false.
The signers array parameter supplies the addresses processed by removeSigners.
removeSigners performs the unchecked activeSignersCount-- counter update.
The unchecked decrement writes to activeSignersCount, weakening the quorum threshold.
The signersCount argument flows into the abstract quorum decision.
The signersCount argument flows into the majority comparison of the concrete quorum implementation.
getAllSignersCount returns the length of the allSigners array.
getAllSigners reads entries from the allSigners array.
getAllSigners exposes each signer's isSigner authorization flag to callers.
getAllSigners uses CHUNK_SIZE as the uint8 loop bound for the returned chunk.
The offset parameter shifts the paging window used by getAllSigners.
getScriptsCount returns the length of the scriptAddresses array.
getAllScripts reads entries from the scriptAddresses array.
getAllScripts reads script state and signCount from the scripts mapping.
getAllScripts uses CHUNK_SIZE as the uint8 loop bound for the returned chunk.
The offset parameter shifts the paging window used by getAllScripts.

normalization_plan.reason: The scriptAddress parameter is only used to index the scripts mapping inside sign.
The scriptAddress parameter is consumed by execute both for the mapping lookup and as the delegatecall target.
The scriptAddress parameter is only used to index the scripts mapping inside cancelScript.
The signers array is iterated only inside addSigners to activate new signers.
The signers array is iterated only inside removeSigners to deactivate signers.
The signersCount parameter is the sole input of the abstract quorum decision.
The offset parameter only shifts the read window of the signer listing helper.
The offset parameter only shifts the read window of the script listing helper.
The signersCount parameter is the sole comparison input of the concrete quorum implementation.
The storage pointer script is a temporary handle on scripts[scriptAddress] used only within sign.
The storage pointer script is a temporary handle on scripts[scriptAddress] used only within execute.
The storage pointer script is a temporary handle on scripts[scriptAddress] used only within cancelScript.
The loop index i exists only to walk the signers array in addSigners.
The loop index i exists only to walk the signers array in removeSigners.
The uint8 loop index i only bounds the CHUNK_SIZE paging loop of getAllSigners.
The uint8 loop index i only bounds the CHUNK_SIZE paging loop of getAllScripts.
The temporary signer address is read, packed into the result and discarded inside getAllSigners.
The temporary script address is read, packed into the result and discarded inside getAllScripts.
The result local only carries the delegatecall outcome out of execute.
